deep.reconstruction:
This page is not a mathematical computation. It is a pencil draft of a letter, almost certainly to Carl Wilhelm Borchardt (addressed as 'Hochgeschätzter Herr Doctor'), editor of Crelle's Journal. It concerns the printing of Riemann's 1857 papers in Crelle 54: 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' and the accompanying preliminary articles, including the analysis situs Lehrsätze. The next page, a draft preface to the Abel-function memoir, supports this context. There are no derivations to reconstruct. The mathematical content lies in the figures and terminology being discussed.

(1) Riemann has learned that the editor will add the figures and may also print Riemann's remarks, which were apparently meant only for the proof-correction stage, wholly or in part. He leaves this to the editor.

(2) The 'fourth figure' depicts a Riemann surface spread over the plane. Riemann explains his drawing convention. The part of the surface belonging to the branch point or cut a_1 is regarded as lying beneath the other sheet, and so its course is shown by dotted lines. If the editor prints the remark 'über den Theilen α β γ δ der Ebene ist die Fläche doppelt' (over the regions α, β, γ, δ the covering surface is two-sheeted), Riemann proposes adding: 'the part of the surface corresponding to a_1 is regarded in the drawing as running beneath the other and is therefore indicated by dotted lines.' In modern terms, the figure is a branched covering of the plane, and these are the regions where the covering has two sheets. Hidden sheets are shown dotted, as in later textbook pictures of Riemann surfaces.

(3) Terminology. The expressions 'Ringfläche' and 'Oberfläche eines Ringes' might give pause on first reading. Riemann thinks they are hardly open to double interpretation. Still, he suggests that at the first occurrence 'Ringfläche' be replaced by 'ebene Ringfläche'. This separates the planar annulus, a doubly connected bounded plane region, from the surface of a ring (the torus surface). The marginal sketches are consistent with this: an oval (a disk, simply connected), a circle with a concentric inner circle (a planar annulus), and two small circles with strokes (possibly cross-cuts or 'Querschnitte'). This last reading is my interpretation.

(4) A further paragraph asks whether a separate printing of his papers could be made available through the book trade. The model he cites is Weierstrass's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen' (Crelle 52, 1856).

Implicit mathematics (my gloss): Riemann's order of connectivity. A bounded surface of genus g with b boundary curves needs 2g+b-1 cross-cuts to become simply connected, so its order of connectivity is 2g+b. A disk is 1-fold connected, a planar annulus 2-fold, and a torus with one hole 3-fold. This is exactly why 'ebene Ringfläche' (2-fold) must not be confused with 'Oberfläche eines Ringes'.
errors: No mathematical errors; the page contains no derivations.

checkable.sympy: g, b = symbols('g b', integer=True); n = 2*g + b; n.subs({g:0, b:2})
checkable.asserts: A planar annulus (genus 0, 2 boundary curves) has Riemann connectivity order 2.
A torus with one hole has connectivity order 3, so 'Oberfläche eines Ringes' differs topologically from 'ebene Ringfläche'.
The Euler characteristic of the annulus is 0.
A disk (the oval sketch) is simply connected (order 1).

transcription_corrections: Addressee is probably Borchardt (Crelle's Journal); 'Herr Doctor' fits C. W. Borchardt.
Line 'Ich ... daß Sie nicht bloß die Figuren hinzufügen': the interlinear words above 'Ich' are more likely 'ersehe aus Ihrem [Schreiben]' than 'ersehe aus Ihrer Schrift'.
'meine freilich für die Correcturen Bemerkungen' probably reads 'meine freilich nur für die Correctur bestimmten Bemerkungen' (uncertain).
'wenn ich ganz Ihrem Ermessen überlassen muß' is more plausibly 'was ich ganz Ihrem Ermessen überlassen muß'.
'abdrucken lassen wollen': 'Lettern?' is written above 'abdrucken'; reading uncertain.
In the remark quoted from the paper, read 'über den Theilen α β γ δ der Ebene ist die Fläche doppelt' (or 'zu den Theilen'); the sense is 'two-sheeted over these regions'.

The struck passage 'Sollte ... vielleicht ohne bedeutende Kosten ...' and the final paragraph concern a separate printing ('besonderer Abdruck') for the book trade like Weierstrass's 'Theorie der Abel'schen Functionen'. Words like 'ähnlich' are guesses.
